## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and why it is needed.

## Safety and research boundary

- [ ] This change does not add a clinical, diagnostic, patient-level, or medical-probability claim.
- [ ] This change does not store raw uploads, commit raw data, expose secrets, or add private signed URLs.
- [ ] Mode B remains unavailable unless the separate full-volume release gate is explicitly evidenced.

## Verification

List commands run and their exact results. Include any browser, API, model, or data-audit evidence relevant to the change.

## Data/model impact

State `none`, or link to the updated dataset audit, experiment ledger, model card, and calibration evidence. Do not attach restricted data or model checkpoints.

## Manual follow-up

List any required owner credentials, legal acceptance, infrastructure change, or reviewer decision. Do not request secrets in the pull request.
